# Outlook Traveller

> > India's leading travel magazine covering responsible tourism, offbeat destinations, culinary journeys, and adventure travel across India and international destinations.

Outlook Traveller is a premier Indian travel publication featuring destination guides, adventure travel, food tourism, wildlife conservation stories, and annual awards recognizing excellence in tourism. The platform emphasizes responsible tourism practices and showcases both popular and offbeat destinations across India (particularly Maharashtra and Western Ghats) and international locations like Germany and Norway.

## Key Topics

- Responsible Tourism
- Maharashtra Tourism
- Western Ghats
- Offbeat Destinations
- Culinary Travel & Street Food
- Adventure Travel & Trekking
- Wildlife Conservation
- German Food Guide & Bavarian Cuisine
- Rural Tourism
- Travel Photography
- Sustainable Travel Practices
- Heritage & Cultural Tourism
- Monsoon Travel
- Coastal Destinations
- Travel Gear & Equipment

## Core Sections & Awards

- [Outlook Traveller Awards - 2025](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/awards/2025): Outlook Traveller Awards 2025 nomination & event page at Hyatt Delhi
- [Explore Maharashtra](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/explore-maharashtra): Maharashtra tourism campaign hub featuring Sandhan Valley & coastal spots
- [Editor's Picks - Celebrating People](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/celebrating-people): Editor's curated travel picks & recommendations from Outlook Traveller
- [Adventure Travel Gateway](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/experiences/adventure): Adventure travel section featuring Himalayan treks & outdoor activities
- [Photo Features](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/see/photo-features): Photo features section showcasing travel photography from India & beyond
- [Outlook Traveller Awards 2024](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/awards/2024): Outlook Traveller Awards 2024 event at Sunder Nursery, New Delhi
- [Indian Responsible Tourism State Awards 2025 - Gujarat](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/irtsa/gujarat-2026): Indian Responsible Tourism State Awards 2025 Gujarat edition page

- [Garbett Plateau Offers Wildflowers, Village Paths & Sweeping Western Ghats Vistas](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/explore-maharashtra/a-cinematic-monsoon-escape-awaits-on-the-quiet-trails-of-garbett-plateau): Garbett Plateau monsoon trek near Matheran in Western Ghats Maharashtra
- [Tucked Away in Raigad, Hemnagar Reveals Konkan Before the Crowds Arrived](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/explore-maharashtra/beyond-alibags-beaches-hemnagar-offers-a-slower-softer-side-of-coastal-maharashtra): Hemnagar village in Raigad offers offbeat Konkan coastal escape
- [Western Ghats Biodiversity Boost As 26 Species Added In Kerala's Vazhachal Forest Survey](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/News/western-ghats-biodiversity-boom-vazhachal-survey-adds-26-species-to-wildlife-checklist-in-kerala): Kerala's Vazhachal Forest survey documents 26 new Western Ghats species

## International Destinations & Culinary Travel

- [Places to Visit in Germany for Serious Foodies](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/gnto/places-to-visit-in-germany-for-serious-foodies): Germany foodie guide featuring Berlin's Currywurst spots & culinary travel
- [Discovering the Flavours of Northern Germany with Parth Bajaj](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/gnto/discovering-the-flavours-of-northern-germany-with-parth-bajaj): Parth Bajaj explores Northern Germany's street food & Christmas markets
- [Exploring Offbeat Day Trips from Hamburg](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/gnto/exploring-offbeat-day-trips-from-hamburg): Hamburg day trips guide to offbeat Northern Germany countryside retreats
- [Chasing Trolls Across Norway: A Journey Through Folklore, Fjords & Fearless Landscapes](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/destinations/international/between-legend-landscape-exploring-the-mythical-world-of-norways-trolls): Norway's troll folklore explored through fjords & mythical landscapes
- [Top 10 Tourist Places To Visit In Singapore](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/ampstories/experiences/places-of-interest/top-10-tourist-places-to-visit-in-singapore): Singapore's top attractions: Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay & more
